body:
## Pensieve 0.6.3

### Fixed
- **Translations and answers** no longer show "\n" where a new line should be.
- **Text inside a figure** (the labels of a pipeline diagram, for example) is no longer taken for headings or body text. It is left as it is, with the figure.
- Running heads and the line numbers of review copies are no longer translated as text.

### New
- **Translations keep the paper's look**: its bold and italics, its formulas, in a typeface like the paper's. Key sentences are highlighted.
- **Point at a sentence of a translation** to see the same sentence in the original and on the PDF page. Click it to go there.
- **Figures explained**: under each caption, the figure itself and a short explanation of what it shows (needs a model that can see pictures, for example a SiliconFlow key; DeepSeek can't read pictures).
- Terms researchers say in English (prompt, embodied AI, world model…) stay in English in Chinese translations.
- **More room to read**: hide the app's sidebar while reading a paper; it slides out when the mouse reaches the left edge.

### Download

| Your system | File |
|---|---|
| Windows 10 / 11 | **Pensieve-Setup-0.6.3.exe** |
| Mac with Apple Silicon | **Pensieve-0.6.3-mac-arm64.zip** |
| Mac with Intel | **Pensieve-0.6.3-mac-x64.zip** |
| Linux (64-bit) | **Pensieve-0.6.3-linux-x86_64.AppImage** or **Pensieve-0.6.3-linux-amd64.deb** |
| Android 8+ (HarmonyOS via 卓易通) | **Pensieve-0.6.3-android.apk** |
| iPhone / iPad (iOS 15+) | **Pensieve-0.6.3-ios-unsigned.ipa** — install with Sideloadly or AltStore ([how](https://photonghost308.github.io/pensieve-app/#ios-install)) |

Already using Pensieve? It updates itself (Settings → General → Updates). Your notes stay as they are.
